nodes.label: Event-driven Lightweight Footprint Requirement
nodes.rationale: The app runs continuously; maintaining ~15 MB footprint and 0% CPU requires reactive triggers (FileWatcher, NSWorkspace notifications, exact timer) instead of polling.

nodes.label: Menu Bar Overflow Module (menuBarOverflow)
nodes.rationale: MacBook notch hides overflow items; a 10,000 pt separator hides them and clicking the belt opens a panel showing hidden items via AXExtrasMenuBar.

nodes.label: App Switcher Module (appSwitcher)
nodes.rationale: Replaces macOS native app switcher with AX + _AXUIElementGetWindow and CGWindowList ordering, avoiding cooperative activation latency.

nodes.label: Clipboard Module (clipboard)
nodes.rationale: Uses a non-activating NSPanel to avoid focus-switching delays (~1 s) during pasting.

nodes.label: System Monitor Module (systemMonitor)
nodes.rationale: Direct kernel calls (host_statistics64, vm.swapusage, statfs) provide fast readings while reusing macscan CLI for full system reports.

nodes.label: Claude Accounts Module (claudeAccounts)
nodes.rationale: Reads cachedUsageUtilization directly from .claude.json via FileWatcher and reset timers without polling or private APIs.

nodes.label: AppUpdater Component
nodes.rationale: Lightweight in-house updater instead of Sparkle; relies on Developer ID Team ID checks and SHA-256 validation.

nodes.label: Native Symbolic HotKey Overriding
nodes.rationale: macOS captures Cmd+Tab before applications; Toolbelt disables symbolic hotkeys (1, 2, 27) via CGS private API and restores them cleanly on exit.

nodes.label: Auto-Update Verification & Replacement Flow
nodes.rationale: Replaces bundle in place via replaceItemAt and launches via NSWorkspace with --relaunch-after to avoid dying with the launchd job.
